documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported a strong start to FY27, achieving its highest-ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, with consolidated revenue growing by 52.1% year-on-year. Management highlighted robust performance across all product segments, strong volume growth outperforming the two-wheeler industry, and strategic operational developments including the commercialization of its Sirsa solar plant and new alloy wheel supplies. Driven by strong demand and new order wins, management revised its full-year revenue growth guidance from mid-teens to high-teens and increased its capex projection to approximately Rs. 700 crore. Additionally, the company noted that aluminum price volatility impacted EBITDA percentage margins through the denominator effect, though absolute margins and back-to-back pass-through mechanisms remain intact.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year revenue growth guidance from mid-teens to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management stated that capital expenditure may reach approximately Rs. 700 crore for the year.
guidance.quote: I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of continuing to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects industry growth to be supported by improving consumer purchasing power and easier vehicle finance access.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we believe the industry will continue to benefit from these far-reaching reforms, improving consumer purchasing power, and easier access to vehicle finance.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the medium-term industry outlook driven by consumer sentiment and expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook, supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labor reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer orders remain robust with OEM customers carrying on with their original production schedules.
demand_outlook.quote: Even the even the orders from the customers are also robust.

capex_expansion.claim: The 9.9-megawatt solar power plant at Sirsa, Haryana is fully operational.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to update that our 9.9-megawatt solar power plant at Sirsa, Haryana has been fully operational and is delivering the sustainable operational economies on the expected lines.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been implemented at the Karoli plant for high-pressure die cast alloy wheel supplies.
capex_expansion.quote: We are happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant, and first supply of high-pressure die cast alloy wheel has started to our esteemed Japanese customer.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to urgently set up a new plant in the South in Bangalore before March.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will be investing around Rs. 400 Cr in capex for the next financial year's growth.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

capex_expansion.claim: FY27 capex is projected to be about Rs. 400 Cr.
capex_expansion.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins as aluminum prices are expected to remain benign.
margins_costs.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the casting line is 100% hedged through back-to-back customer pass-throughs, keeping absolute margins stable.
margins_costs.quote: In our this casting line, we have to see the absolute EBITDA, which as I have always explained, because there is 100% pass-through with the customer, back-to-back, we are fully hedged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 12.1% and was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin was 13.1% and was impacted by pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed alloy wheel orders stand at Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports to Ford Motors are expected to be around Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and increase to Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Karoli plant capacity utilization increased from 60%-65% to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Bangalore plant capacity utilization has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Karoli plant capacity utilization is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be utilized for capex, supplemented by external term loans for machines if needed.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management expects debt-to-equity to remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The company effected a strategic reduction and closure of the low value-added Wheel Assembly business, resulting in nil sales from Wheel Assembly effective April 1, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Strategic Closure of low value-added Wheel Assembly business

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: All internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia created volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, sharply increasing aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy and caused undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports declined to Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 due to trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The newly planned plant in Bangalore is expected to be operationalized before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Initial supplies for sunroof cables will start from H2.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: Alloy wheel supplies to the Japanese customer will begin in the beginning of H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The alloy wheel supplies to the Japanese customer in the beginning of the H2, so this current year you'll see much higher capacity utilization in the Karoli plant also.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
